migrationNotes: The page has no prose at all — four event headings, sixteen champion/runner-up graphics, and four published Google Sheets. The sheets are the results; nothing was transcribed.
All four sheet URLs returned HTTP 200 when checked on 2026-08-30.
The names and placings in the gallery captions were read off the graphics themselves.

The four champion graphics for Men's and Women's Singles are the same files already rescued to photos/archive/2025/2025-u-s-nationals-team-singles-players/ and are referenced there rather than downloaded again. The remaining twelve graphics do not appear in archive-data.json and were downloaded to photos/pages/2025-usplaydowns-full-results-1/.
Squarespace served each graphic twice (a lightbox duplicate); only one copy of each is kept.
Iframe heights were not usable from the source markup; 600 recorded for every embed.
A /2025-usplaydowns-full-results-1 rewrite still needs adding to vercel.json — outside the scope of this migration pass.
